resources.string: These details appear on your report for the doctor. They stay on your phone and can be changed in Settings.
Add the medications you take, from the list or by typing their name. Each one can have a reminder: daily, every 2 weeks, monthly…
No treatment yet. You can also add them later in the Care tab.
Tap “Stool”, pick the Bristol type, from hard (1) to watery (7), and save. Add blood, mucus, pain or fatigue when needed. Log your meals with a photo or by scanning a barcode.
History: your month at a glance
The calendar colors each day: green for normal stools, orange for loose or watery ones. Tap a day to see and edit what you logged.
Trends: see how you are doing
The chart shows your stools day by day, with a red dot when blood is reported. Compare the last 30 days, 90 days or your whole history, and count the days with symptoms.
Your treatments are there. You can also schedule blood tests and stool tests (calprotectin) with a reminder on the right day, and keep your lab results, typed in or imported from a lab report.

Every evening at 7 pm, a notification lets you log your stool type, pain and fatigue directly, without opening the app; it stays until all three are filled in. Treatment and test reminders use notifications too. You can change the time in Settings.
